evals.name: pr-readiness
evals.prompt: I'm about to open a PR. Can you check that all of our markdown docs are consistent with each other and up to date with the code? Report only, don't change any files.
evals.expected_output: Runs the docs verifier, reports a verdict with errors/warnings, and does a judgment pass for duplicated ownership and contradictions.
assertions: States an explicit overall verdict (pass / pass with warnings / fail)
Actually ran the control-doc verifiers (check:docs or verify-control-docs) rather than assuming they pass
Reports that verify-health is missing from the AGENTS.md skill routing table
Reports the unlinked docs under docs/ (guide/ files and the worktree report)
Cites concrete file paths for every finding

evals.name: skills-and-scripts-sync
evals.prompt: I've been adding skills and shuffling scripts around this week. Are the docs still in sync with what's actually in .agents/skills and scripts/? Just report what's out of sync, don't edit anything.
evals.expected_output: Finds project skills missing from the AGENTS.md routing table and any undocumented scripts, using the verifier plus manual cross-checks.
assertions: Reports all five project skills missing from AGENTS.md routing: agents-dev-cli, docs-research, new-component, skill-guide, verify-health
Cross-checks .agents/skills against the AGENTS.md routing table (does not just skim one list)
Cites concrete file paths for every finding
States what was not verified or the scope of the check

evals.name: routing-and-links
evals.prompt: Do all the relative links in our docs resolve, and do the docs under docs/ (ADRs, exec plans, product specs) follow the repo's own rules? Report only, no edits.
evals.expected_output: Reports link/anchor validity and docs/ tree rule compliance (ADR numbering, plan sections, spec index, orphan docs).
assertions: States whether relative links resolve, backed by an actual programmatic or scripted check (not eyeballing)
Reports the three docs with no inbound links (two docs/guide files plus the worktree report)
Checks ADR numbering and filename rules (0001-0007 contiguous, kebab-case)
Notes the non-ASCII/Portuguese text in CONTEXT.md and the product spec as needing confirmation
Cites concrete file paths for every finding
